source: Mande & de Wolf, Tight bounds for quantum phase estimation and related problems, arXiv:2305.04908v3, Quantum 10, 2140 (2026), Thm 1.3 and proof of Claim 5.2 (p.13)
value: t >= ln(1/(2*eps_fail))/(48*delta_phase) applications of controlled-U / U^-1 (explicit constant read off the proof: 1/(2 eps) <= exp(48 t delta))
label: literature
note: phase-estimation access; precision delta, failure eps; Omega((1/delta)log(1/eps)) tight; constant 1/48 is weak

source: Nayak & Wu STOC'99 (quant-ph/9804066) as cited in Mande-de Wolf p.4 and Rall-Fuller p.3
value: Omega(1/eps) for approximate counting / amplitude estimation at constant success; no explicit constant read
label: literature

value: O(n) code runs give error sigma/n w.h.p.; dependence on n optimal; no explicit constants, no delta stated in abstract
label: literature

source: Berry et al., Analyzing prospects for quantum advantage in topological data analysis, arXiv:2209.13581 (PRX Quantum 5, 010319 (2024)), Lemma 4 eq.(23), App. D eqs.(D12)-(D15)
value: N = (pi/eps_phase)*sqrt(1+alpha^2) = (1/(2 eps_phase)) ln(1/delta) + O(eps^-1 ln ln(1/delta)) calls to W or W^dagger, with ln(1/delta) ~= 2 pi alpha - ln[8 ln(2 alpha) sqrt(alpha)]
label: literature
note: asymptotic/approximate derivation (Gaussian normalisation approx, Bessel asymptotics); NOT a certified finite worst-case constant -> 'no explicit constant' for k_lo; usable only as modelled value

source: Patel, Tan, Subasi, Sornborger, Optimal coherent QPE via tapering, arXiv:2403.18927v3, Thm 2 (eq.33) and Thm 3 (eq.47)
value: non-asymptotic: m = ceil(log2(175 (log(10/delta)+1)^2 + 1)) + 1 extra ancilla bits (average-case over phase only); asymptotic Thm 3 uses Slepian asymptotics (no finite constant)
label: literature
note: explicit non-asymptotic constant is ~1e3x worse than canonical and average-case only; DPSS taper is the exact average-case optimum

source: Rall & Fuller, Amplitude estimation from quantum signal processing, Quantum 7, 937 (2023), arXiv:2207.08628v3, Empirical Claims 18 and 20, Prop. 19
value: ChebAE ~4.66/eps queries at 95% (empirical fit, amplitude a); IQAE ~9.93/eps (empirical); BHMT closed form ~50/eps at 95%
label: literature
note: empirical fits at 95%, not worst-case 99% guarantees -> 'no explicit constant'

source: Nakaji, Faster amplitude estimation, arXiv:2003.02417 Thm 1 eq.(29)
value: N_orac < 4.1e3/eps * ln(4 log2(2 pi/(3 eps))/delta) calls of Q; eps is error on amplitude a (not probability)
label: literature
note: explicit but ~2 orders worse than canonical; not pursued
